en: Black‑and‑white (tinted) postcard showing a group of uniformed soldiers standing in front of a large gated entrance to a military barracks. The gate is flanked by brick and stone walls with decorative lamps, and a striped guardhouse stands on the right with a sentry holding a rifle. At the bottom, printed in red German text, is a caption identifying the place and military unit.
